verdict.rationale: Phaser ships an editor, a hosted Game Agent and an MCP server, so asking whether those automations can be versioned, reviewed and rolled back is a fair question. Nothing in the evidence documents versioning, change review, history or rollback for agent- or editor-driven changes. Exporting project files to VS Code is at most a user-side workaround and earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
